Name: Updated Seasonal Japanese Buildings
Author: Leroymilo
Description:
[size=6]This is an update to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3947]Seasonal Japanese Buildings mod[/url] from [i]SonreirAngel[/i] for Stardew Valley [b]1.6[/b] (and later).[/size]
[size=5]I will not make new Textures myself because I am not an artist, but I accept submissions of sprites to add to the Mod.[/size]

[color=#00ff00][size=4]NEW: AT version and Building skins option[/size][/color]

[size=4][url=https://github.com/Leroymilo/USJB/blob/main/README.md]complete list of features and credits[/url][/size]

[size=3]Modular Obelisks Showcase
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Leroymilo/USJB/main/images/obelisks.gif[/img]
[/size]

[size=3]Building Showcase (incomplete) :
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Leroymilo/USJB/main/images/Buildings%20Showcase.gif[/img][/size]

[size=5]Recommendations:[/size]

[size=3]The [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9670]Golden Clock reskin[/url] by [i]Kove[/i].
The [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44466]Fish Pond[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25353/]Grandpa's Shed[/url] for SVE, and an [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27097]Alternative Silo[/url] by [i]Otterhead[/i][/size]

[b][size=4]/!\ This is not my art[/size][/b][size=3], I only updated it (with the authorization of the authors). If you want to use it, contact the creators linked on this page.[/size]

[size=3]A lot of suggestions to extend this mod to other buildings have been made in the posts, but I'm not an artist. However, if you are an artist and would like to include new buildings, please see this [url=https://github.com/Leroymilo/USJB/blob/main/TODO.md]To-do-list[/url]﻿ to see what can be added to this mod, then you can contact me on discord so that I can include your participation in the mod.


F.A.Q. :

Q : It doesn't work at all, what do I do?
A : Check if you properly installed all the [b]requirements[/b]. Check if you [b]unzipped[/b] the mod in the right place, check if no [b]other mods[/b] are overwriting this one. Check that the correct [b]options[/b] are enabled in mod options (at the very bottom of the options tab) if you're using Generic Mod Config Menu. Only the farm house, farm buildings and some craftables are modified by this mod, not town buildings. If you absolutely can't fix your issue, you can leave a post on this mod [b]including your [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url][/b] (I won't answer if there is no log).

Q : Why are my building having weird colors?
A : You're using paint on them, in the latest version of this mod the paint should be applied properly. If you see strange color after changing the mod config or after a season change, try to save your changes, then restart the game.

Q : Animated Statue / Well is not moving.
A : Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url], enable animations in the Generic Mod Config Menu.[/size]
